title: 致电餐厅订年底聚餐，问定金和套餐
titleEn: Calling a restaurant to book a big end-of-year family dinner
scene: 年底快到了，你想订一家意大利餐厅 Nonna Bruna's，12 月初请亲戚吃顿饭：一共 12 个人，8 个大人、4 个小孩。下午你打电话过去，接电话的是店员 Matt。餐厅还没开晚市，他一边忙一边接电话，语速很快，金额和规定一口气说完，还夹着 a head、corkage、drop off 这些说法。
你的目标：① 订到合适的时段，听清要几点离桌；② 问清大桌只能点套餐、价格、高脚椅，说明一位麸质不耐（coeliac）和一位素食者的饮食要求；③ 问清定金、取消规定、自带酒和分账，最后复述一遍，并让对方发短信确认。

facts.v: 8 个大人 + 4 个小孩，要 1 张高脚椅
套餐：成人 $65 / 位，儿童 $22 / 位
每位成人 $20，共 $160，48 小时内付，从总账里扣

vocab.ex: We've got two sittings that night.

vocab.zh: 翻台，把桌子让给下一批客人
vocab.ex: We need to turn the table over by half seven.
Groups of ten or more are set menu only.
It's sixty-five a head for adults.
You start with share plates for the table.
Could we please have one high chair?

vocab.zh: 饮食要求（dietary requirements 的口语说法）
vocab.ex: Any dietaries I should know about?

vocab.zh: 乳糜泻患者，不能吃麸质（读 "see-lee-ak"）

vocab.ex: Is there a risk of cross-contamination in the kitchen?
Corkage is fifteen dollars a bottle.
We take a deposit for big groups.
We need your final numbers by the Wednesday before.

listening.en: Bear with me a sec, I'll just bring it up on the system.
listening.sound: Bear with me 读 "bair-with-mee"，= 请稍等；bring it up 连读 "bring-i-dup"，= 在电脑上调出来。听到这句就等一下，不用说话
listening.zh: 稍等一下，我在系统里看看。

listening.en: We've gotta have the table back by half seven, 'cause we turn it over for the next lot.
listening.sound: gotta = got to；half seven = 七点半；the next lot = 下一批人，lot 在这里不是"很多"
listening.zh: 七点半前要把桌子腾出来，因为要给下一批客人。
listening.reply: Just to confirm, we need to leave by seven-thirty?

listening.en: Groups of ten or more, it's set menu only, I'm afraid. Sixty-five a head.
listening.sound: I'm afraid 读 "m'fraid"，只是客气的"不好意思"，不是害怕；a head = 每人。sixty 重音在前，注意和 seventy 分清
listening.zh: 不好意思，十人以上只能点套餐，每人六十五。
listening.reply: Sorry, was that sixty-five or seventy-five?

listening.en: Any dietaries I should know about? Is she proper coeliac, or just avoiding it?
listening.sound: dietaries 读 "die-uh-trees"；proper = 真正的。对方问的是医学上的乳糜泻，还是自己选择不吃麸质，这关系到厨房怎么处理
listening.zh: 有什么饮食要求吗？她是真的乳糜泻，还是只是不想吃？
listening.reply: She's properly coeliac, so even a small amount makes her sick.

listening.en: If it's not paid within forty-eight hours, the booking just drops off.
listening.sound: forty-eight 的 t 弱化，像 "for-dee-ate"；drops off = 从系统里自动取消，不是"送人"的意思
listening.zh: 如果 48 小时内没付，预订就自动取消了。
listening.reply: Okay, I'll pay it today. Could you text me the link?

listening.en: Reckon you'd be right to pay it this arvo? Then you're all locked in.
listening.sound: you'd be right to = 你方便……吗；arvo = 下午；locked in = 定下来了，不会变
listening.zh: 你今天下午方便付吗？付了就定下来了。
listening.reply: Yes, I'll do that as soon as I get your text.

speech.topic: 我为什么不再害怕打电话订餐厅
paragraphs: When I first came to Australia, I always booked restaurants online. I was too nervous to call. I was afraid the staff would speak too fast, and I was afraid they would get annoyed if I asked them to repeat things. So if a restaurant had no online booking, I just chose a different one.

But last year I needed a table for a big family dinner, and the website only took bookings for up to eight people. I had no choice. I had to pick up the phone. Before I called, I wrote down everything I needed: the date, the number of people, and a list of questions.

The call was not easy. The man on the phone spoke very quickly, and he said a lot of numbers. But I told him, "Sorry, my English isn't perfect. Could you say that a bit slower?" He just said, "No worries," and slowed down. He wasn't annoyed at all.

That day I learned something important. When people work in a restaurant, they talk to all kinds of customers. They would much rather repeat something than get the booking wrong. Asking a question is not rude. It actually saves them time.

Now I have a simple routine. I prepare my questions, I repeat the key details back, and I ask them to send me a text. I also call in the afternoon, when the restaurant is quiet. I still get a bit nervous, but I can do it. Next time, I think I might even enjoy it.
speech.zh: 刚来澳洲时，我总是在网上订餐厅，不敢打电话，怕对方说得太快，也怕让人重复会惹人烦。去年要订一次大的家庭聚餐，网站最多只能订八个人，只好打电话。打之前我写下了日期、人数和问题。电话并不容易，对方语速快、数字多，但我告诉他我英语不够好，请他说慢一点，他说 no worries 就放慢了，一点也没不耐烦。我明白了：餐厅员工每天接待各种客人，宁可重复一遍也不愿订错，提问并不失礼，反而省时间。现在我有固定流程：准备问题、复述要点、请对方发短信，还会挑餐厅不忙的下午打。虽然还有点紧张，但我能做到了。

patterns.en: I was too nervous to ___, so I just ___.
patterns.zh: 说以前不敢做什么，以及怎么躲开的

patterns.en: I had no choice. I had to ___.
patterns.zh: 说是什么逼你迈出了第一步
说这件事让你明白了什么

patterns.en: Now I have a simple routine. I ___, I ___, and I ___.
patterns.zh: 用三个动作说你现在的做法

lines.en: Good arvo, Nonna Bruna's, Matt speaking, how can I help?
lines.zh: 下午好，Nonna Bruna's，我是 Matt，有什么可以帮您？

lines.en: Hi Matt. I'd like to book a table for a family dinner, please. It's for twelve people, on Saturday the fifth of December.
lines.zh: 你好 Matt。我想订一桌家庭聚餐，十二个人，十二月五号星期六。

lines.en: Twelve, righto. Ooh, December's filling up pretty quick, I'll tell ya. Bear with me a sec, I'll just bring it up on the system. Yeah, look, we can fit you in. We've got two sittings that night, five-thirty or seven forty-five. Which one suits?
lines.zh: 十二位，好的。哎呀，十二月订得很快。稍等，我在系统里看一下。嗯，是这样，排得下。那天晚上有两轮，五点半或七点四十五。哪个合适？

lines.en: Sorry, could you say the times again a bit slower?
lines.zh: 不好意思，能再慢一点说一遍时间吗？

lines.en: Yeah, no worries. Five-thirty, or seven forty-five. With the early one, we've gotta have the table back by half seven, 'cause we turn it over for the next lot.
lines.zh: 好，没问题。五点半，或者七点四十五。早的那轮要在七点半前把桌子腾出来，因为要给下一批客人。

lines.en: Just to confirm, if we come at five-thirty, we need to leave by seven-thirty?
lines.zh: 我确认一下，如果五点半来，七点半前要走，对吗？

lines.en: That's the one, yep. Most families go for the early one, to be honest. By eight o'clock the kids are climbing the walls.
lines.zh: 对，没错。说实话大多数家庭都选早场。到八点孩子们就闹翻天了。

lines.en: Ha, that's true. Four of the twelve are kids, so five-thirty is perfect. Do you have high chairs? My nephew is only eighteen months old.
lines.zh: 哈，确实。十二个人里有四个小孩，五点半正好。你们有高脚椅吗？我侄子才十八个月大。

lines.en: Yep, we've got a couple. I'll pop one down for you. Now, the other thing is, groups of ten or more, it's set menu only, I'm afraid. Sixty-five a head for the adults. You get share plates to start, a choice of two mains, then dessert. Kids are twenty-two, that's a pasta, a drink and a gelato.
lines.zh: 有，我们有几张。给您记一张。还有，不好意思，十人以上只能点套餐。成人每位六十五，先上分享小盘，主菜两选一，还有甜点。小孩二十二，含一份意面、一杯饮料和一份意式冰淇淋。

lines.en: Sorry, was that sixty-five or seventy-five for adults?
lines.zh: 不好意思，成人是六十五还是七十五？

lines.en: Sixty-five. Six, five. Any dietaries I should know about?
lines.zh: 六十五。六、五。有什么饮食要求吗？

lines.en: Yes, two. One person is vegetarian, and my sister-in-law is coeliac.
lines.zh: 有，两个。一位吃素，我嫂子是乳糜泻，不能吃麸质。

lines.en: Vego's no dramas at all. With the coeliac, is she proper coeliac, or just avoiding it? We can do gluten-free pasta, no worries, but it's a pretty small kitchen.
lines.zh: 素食完全没问题。乳糜泻的话，她是真的有这个病，还是只是不想吃？无麸质意面我们能做，但厨房挺小的。

lines.en: She's properly coeliac, so even a small amount makes her sick. Is there a risk of cross-contamination?
lines.zh: 她是真的乳糜泻，一点点都会不舒服。会有交叉污染的风险吗？

lines.en: Good on ya for asking. I don't wanna guess on that one. The chef's in at four, so I'll get him to give you a bell this arvo, and you can run through it with him. That alright?
lines.zh: 您问得好。这个我不想乱说。厨师四点到，我让他今天下午给您打个电话，您可以跟他仔细说。这样行吗？

lines.en: Yes, that's great, thank you. Do we need to pay a deposit?
lines.zh: 好的，太好了，谢谢。我们需要付定金吗？

lines.en: Yeah, we do for big groups. It's twenty bucks a head for the adults, and that comes off the bill on the night. I'll text you a link, but if it's not paid within forty-eight hours, the booking just drops off. And we need seven days' notice if you cancel, otherwise you lose it. Oh, and final numbers by the Wednesday before.
lines.zh: 要的，大桌都要。成人每位二十块，当晚从账单里扣。我发短信给您链接，但四十八小时内没付的话，预订就自动取消了。取消要提前七天通知，否则定金不退。对了，最终人数要在前一个星期三之前确认。

lines.en: Let me check I've got this right. Eight adults, so that's a hundred and sixty dollars. It comes off the bill, and we get it back if we cancel at least seven days before. Is that right?
lines.zh: 我确认一下。八个大人，也就是一百六十块。从账单里扣，如果至少提前七天取消就能退。对吗？

lines.en: Spot on. You've got it.
lines.zh: 完全正确。

lines.en: Great. Can we bring our own wine? And can we split the bill at the end?
lines.zh: 太好了。我们能自己带酒吗？最后可以分开结账吗？

lines.en: Yep, BYO's fine, bottled wine only, and corkage is fifteen a bottle. And we can split it, but only evenly, not item by item. Too hard on a Saturday night, mate. What name was it for the booking?
lines.zh: 可以，能带酒，只限瓶装葡萄酒，开瓶费每瓶十五。账单能分，但只能平分，不能按每人点的算。周六晚上太忙了。预订用什么名字？

lines.en: Amy Chen. That's C-H-E-N. My mobile is 0491 570 156. Could you text me all the details with the link, please?
lines.zh: Amy Chen，C-H-E-N。我的手机是 0491 570 156。能把所有细节和链接一起发短信给我吗？

lines.en: Too easy. Reckon you'd be right to pay it this arvo? Then you're all locked in. Chef'll give you a bell after four. See you on the fifth!
lines.zh: 没问题。您今天下午方便付吗？付了就定下来了。厨师四点后给您打电话。五号见！

lines.en: Yes, I'll do that as soon as I get your text. Thanks for your help, Matt. Bye!
lines.zh: 好的，收到短信我马上付。谢谢你，Matt。再见！

rescue.en: Sorry, I missed that. Could you say the price again, a bit slower?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，没听清。能再慢一点说一遍价格吗？

rescue.en: Sorry, was that fifteen or fifty?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，是十五还是五十？

rescue.en: Sorry, I'm not sure what corkage means. Could you explain that?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，我不太清楚 corkage 是什么意思，能解释一下吗？

rescue.en: Could you text me the details, so I don't get anything wrong?
rescue.zh: 能用短信把细节发给我吗？这样我不会弄错。

rescue.en: Just to check I've got this right, it's ___ a head, and we need to ___ by ___?
rescue.zh: 我确认一下，每人___，我们要在___之前___，对吗？

checklist: 我听到 two sittings 和 half seven 时，知道要选时段、几点离桌
我能听出 a head 是每人，并分清 sixty-five 和 seventy-five
我能说清 8 个大人、4 个小孩，并开口要一张高脚椅
我能说明 coeliac 和 vegetarian，并问出 cross-contamination 的风险
我听懂了 corkage、drops off 和 final numbers
我挂电话前能复述定金和取消规定，并请对方发短信确认
